notes: The scholarship page does not list eligible courses. The master's list here is derived from the official A-Z of postgraduate courses (173 listed; 2027 intake shown on course pages): kept are courses with a full-time option whose award is a master's degree (M.Sc., M.Phil., LL.M., M.F.A., M.Ed., M.S.W., P.M.E.) and whose course page names a school outside the excluded areas. 84 master's courses recorded.

Left out as excluded areas (school or programme named on the course page): all Trinity Business School programmes (Accounting and Analytics, Business Analytics and AI for Management, Digital Marketing Strategy, Entrepreneurship and Innovation, Finance, Financial Risk Management, Human Resource Management, International Management, Management, Marketing, MBA, Operations and Supply Chain Management, Responsible Business and Sustainability), Law and Finance (joint with the Business School), all School of Engineering courses (Biomedical Engineering, Climate Adaptation Engineering, Computational Engineering, Electronic Information Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Music and Media Technologies, Zero Carbon Technology, the Engineering route in Environmental, Structural and Geotechnical, Transport and Sustainable Energy), all School of Computer Science and Statistics courses (four MSc Computer Science strands, Interactive Digital Media, Statistics and Sustainability), all School of Natural Sciences courses (Biodiversity and Conservation, Development Practice, Environmental Sciences, Smart and Sustainable Cities) and Energy Science (named by the E3 page).

Judgement calls: courses from other science schools (Physics, Mathematics, Biochemistry and Immunology) are kept because the page excludes natural sciences and the E3 route lists only the School of Natural Sciences. High Performance Computing (School of Mathematics), Quantum Fields, Strings and Gravity, Quantum Science and Technology, Immunology and Immunotherapeutics could be treated as excluded by Trinity; confirm with Trinity. Global Health lists no school on its course page. Advanced Radiation Therapy Practice (Online) offers full-time or part-time.

Left out because part-time only, online-only or short: all courses listed as part-time only and the P.Grad.Cert short courses; Nursing - Advancing Child Health and Wellbeing (the title says 1 year full-time but the listing says 2 years part-time); full-time diplomas without a master's award (Old Irish P.Grad.Dip., Healthcare Innovation P.Grad.Dip., Clinical Exercise Online Diploma, Midwifery H.Dip., Children's Nursing H.Dip., Psychology H.Dip.); and professional doctorates (D.Clin.Psych., D.Couns.Psych., D.Ch.Dent.).
The scholarship round is 2026/27; course pages now show the 2027 intake. The scholarship also requires non-EU fee status and excludes students from China (Claddagh scholarship instead).
not_stated: The scholarship page names no eligible course or school, only the excluded areas. The mapping of individual courses to the excluded areas is made from each course page's school.
programmes_note: Trinity does not publish a list of eligible courses, only the areas that are excluded. The courses below are the full-time master's courses in Trinity's postgraduate A-Z that lie outside those areas, selected by SAS; each course page says what applies. Physics, Mathematics, Biochemistry and Immunology and High Performance Computing may count as natural sciences for this scholarship.
